mapper.select: SELECT id, name, category_id FROM sub_categories WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT sc.id, sc.name, sc.category_id FROM categories c RIGHT JOIN sub_categories sc ON c.id = sc.category_id WHERE c.id = (SELECT category_id FROM sub_categories WHERE id = #{subCategoryId}) ORDER BY sc.display_order ASC NULLS LAST
SELECT id, name, category_id FROM sub_categories WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY display_order ASC NULLS LAST
SELECT id, name, category_id as categoryId, display_order FROM sub_categories WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, category_id, display_order FROM sub_categories WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND display_order = #{displayOrder} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, name, category_id as categoryId, display_order FROM sub_categories WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY display_order ASC
SELECT id, name, category_id as categoryId, display_order FROM sub_categories WHERE is_default = true AND category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sub_categories (name, category_id, display_order) VALUES ( #{name}, #{categoryId}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(display_order), 0) + 1 FROM sub_categories) )
